name: Aerilate
desc: Normal moves become Flying type and gain power.

name: Armor Tail
desc: Opponents cannot use priority moves against this side.

name: Blaze
desc: Fire moves are stronger when the user has 1/3 or less HP.

name: Chlorophyll
desc: Speed doubles in harsh sunlight.

name: Cud Chew
desc: Eats a used Berry again at the end of the next turn.

name: Defiant
desc: Attack rises by 2 when another Pokémon lowers this one's stats.

name: Drizzle
desc: Summons rain on entry.

name: Drought
desc: Summons harsh sunlight on entry.

name: Emergency Exit
desc: Switches out when HP falls below half.

name: Good as Gold
desc: Immune to status moves used by other Pokémon.

name: Grassy Surge
desc: Sets Grassy Terrain on entry.

name: Heatproof
desc: Halves damage from Fire moves and burns.

name: Hospitality
desc: Heals the ally a little on entry.

name: Infiltrator
desc: Moves ignore screens and substitutes.

name: Intimidate
desc: Lowers adjacent foes' Attack by 1 on entry.

name: Keen Eye
desc: Accuracy cannot be lowered.

name: Levitate
desc: Immune to Ground moves.

name: Lightning Rod
desc: Draws in Electric moves and raises Sp. Atk.

name: Moxie
desc: Attack rises by 1 after knocking out a Pokémon.

name: No Guard
desc: Moves used by or against this Pokémon always hit.

name: Overgrow
desc: Grass moves are stronger when the user has 1/3 or less HP.

name: Own Tempo
desc: Cannot be confused; immune to Intimidate.

name: Poison Touch
desc: Contact moves may poison the target.

name: Prankster
desc: Status moves gain +1 priority.

name: Pressure
desc: Opposing moves aimed at this Pokémon use extra PP.

name: Psychic Surge
desc: Sets Psychic Terrain on entry.

name: Rain Dish
desc: Restores a little HP each turn in rain.

name: Rough Skin
desc: Attackers making contact lose 1/8 of their max HP.

name: Sand Veil
desc: Evasion rises in a sandstorm.

name: Sap Sipper
desc: Absorbs Grass moves and raises Attack.

name: Solar Power
desc: Sp. Atk rises in harsh sunlight, but HP is lost each turn.

name: Stalwart
desc: Ignores moves and abilities that redirect attacks.

name: Stamina
desc: Defense rises by 1 when hit by an attack.

name: Static
desc: Contact may paralyze the attacker.

name: Sturdy
desc: Survives a one-hit KO from full HP with 1 HP.

name: Supreme Overlord
desc: Attack and Sp. Atk rise for each fainted ally.

name: Synchronize
desc: Passes burn, poison or paralysis back to the Pokémon that caused it.

name: Tough Claws
desc: Contact moves are stronger.

name: Unburden
desc: Speed doubles after the held item is used or lost.
